FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Candy Lane, Suite 100, Sweet Town, ST 56789-1234
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Officer, Candyland Delights, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@candylanddelights.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Candyland Delights, our core operations revolve around providing a wide selection of high-quality candies and confections in a vibrant retail environment. We specialize in sourcing products exclusively from licensed and inspected manufacturers, ensuring all items are safe and compliant with local health regulations. Our store features bulk self-serve bins, and we implement strict sanitation controls to uphold hygiene standards and prevent contamination. We also prioritize clear allergen labeling on all products to facilitate informed customer choices. Our retail space is designed to enhance the shopping experience while maintaining a focus on candy and confectionery, with non-candy items representing a small portion of our total sales. We operate our business with strong inventory management and employee training to ensure exceptional customer service and adherence to food safety protocols. Our shop hours are convenient for customers, while security measures are in place to safeguard our merchandise and provide a safe shopping environment.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Candyland Sweet Treats, LLC - A seasonal pop-up candy store specializing in locally sourced confections, operating from April through October at various community events and fairs.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, we experienced a loss due to water damage caused by a burst plumbing pipe in the ceiling, leading to damages estimated at $1,000. The damages were fully repaired, and the status is resolved. Additionally, we incurred $250 in lost inventory due to contamination from the leak, which has been addressed and reported to our local health department as per regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Steel Safe, Grade B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Installation of motion-activated security cameras and regular security patrols to enhance safety and theft prevention.
